Co chcem zbierat na tomto blogu
blog_posts.summary: Recepty, trasy, oblubene miesta, fotky, poznamky a vsetky male radosti.
content: Tento archiv bude miesto pre veci, ktore nechcem stratit: recepty, vyletove trasy, poznamky, napady a male objavy.
Neskor tu mozu byt galerie, tagy, vyhladavanie alebo samostatne kategorie.

recipes.name: Letne cestoviny
recipes.ingredients: cestoviny, paradajky, bazalka, syr, olivovy olej
recipes.summary: Super ked nechces varit nic zlozite.
content: Uvar cestoviny, nakrajaj paradajky, pridaj bazalku, syr a olivovy olej.
Toto je len zakladny zapis. Neskor sem mozes dopisat presny postup, cas varenia a vlastne hodnotenie.

recipes.name: Medovy caj
content: Sprav si oblubeny caj, nechaj ho trochu vychladnut a az potom pridaj med s citronom.
Je to maly ritual na vecer, nie komplikovany recept.

routes.name: Prechadzka pri vode
content: Sem si mozes napisat popis trasy, odkial sa zacina, co je po ceste a ci sa oplati ist rano alebo vecer.
Neskor sem mozes pridat mapu, fotky alebo oblubene zastavky.

routes.name: Lesny okruh
routes.summary: Sem si pridaj fotky alebo mapu neskor.
content: Lesny okruh je miesto pre dlhsi popis vyletu, poznamky k terenu a male tipy.
Ak pridas obrazok do img, dopis jeho nazov do images.

books.summary: Dystopian classic set in a future where books are outlawed and "firemen" burn any that are discovered.
books.rich_content: Honestly, I cant say I havent enjoyed this book. It was fresh and original, a first book Ive read in a while. The beginning started off really good, but then after Montags meetup with Faber, the plot went on too quickly for me. The end was quite boring for me and I had bigger expectations for it. Im disappointed that Clarisse was removed from the story so early on...
content: Honestly, I cant say I havent enjoyed this book. It was fresh and original, a first book Ive read in a while.
